newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened lower on Friday, weighed down by profit-taking. After healthy gains for the past two trading days, participants were keen to adjust their positions ahead of the three-day weekend, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average was down 149.11 points or 0.73 percent at 20,370.14 after the first 10 minutes of trade. September futures fell 120 points to 20,450.

Brokers expect the Tokyo market to retain a firm tone, but there are strong profit-taking pressures between 20,500 and 21,000, which may dampen the key market index for a while, the brokers added. The bourse is closed on Monday for a holiday.
